preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

postconditions.expression: return_value == all(node is not None for node in level_order_traversal(root) if node is not None) and all(node is None for node in level_order_traversal(root) if node is None and any(n is not None for n in level_order_traversal(root)[level_order_traversal(root).index(node)+1:]))
postconditions.description: The tree is complete if all nodes are filled from left to right at every level, and no gaps exist before the last level.
